plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and focusing on income and broad market exposure, leading to lower potential drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets approximately 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. It seeks risk-first growth, aiming for moderate volatility and steady gains.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring tech names. It accepts higher volatility and the risk of larger drawdowns, especially due to leveraged ETF rebalancing and decay.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI and cutting all leveraged and high-beta single names. It aims for very low drawdowns and consistent distributions, treating it more like cash for yield.
